claim: BaseAgentConfiguration includes cycle_budget, cycles_remaining and cycle_count; None allows continuous execution, 1 requests approval per step, 0 stops.
Classic Agent settings include episodic action history and context; Agent initialization composes file, code, web, todo, watchdog and skill components.
Early AutoGPT used retrieval-based memory over intermediate agent-tool steps for long-running goals; BabyAGI differs by explicitly planning a sequence and updating the task list.
notes: Contemporary technical analysis, not the canonical AutoGPT specification.

claim: LLM-Agent planning literature can be organized into task decomposition, plan selection, external modules, reflection and memory.

claim: Agent evaluation research identifies capability, application-specific and generalist benchmarks and highlights cost-efficiency, safety and robustness as open evaluation challenges.

Under an independent fixed per-step success probability p, the probability that all n steps succeed in one pass is p^n; p=0.95 and n=20 gives approximately 0.358, p=0.98 and n=20 gives approximately 0.668.
locator: Elementary product rule under independence; pedagogical calculation
notes: Simplifying assumption only; not a measured AutoGPT result or realistic calibrated task model.
